card.name: Table column breaks in Windows-Mac comparisons
card.fires_on: Mostly the cell divider (||) or a bracket in a table comparing Windows terms with Mac OS X terms. Weaker on small words like 'to', 'in', 'the' in computer how-to text.

modes.label: Table cell dividers
modes.description: The divider between a Windows item and its Mac equivalent in a comparison table.

modes.label: Small words in computer text
modes.description: Short linking words in sentences about computer settings or file systems.
